responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s high-level planning policy for interprocedural exploration. This file builds a callgraph-based reverse postorder over GCC cgraph nodes, records per-function ordering for the exploded-graph worklist, and decides when a call edge should be handled via a cached call summary rather than explicit call/return simulation, using analyzer options, caller counts, and supergraph size thresholds.
same_name_distinction: Defines the analysis_plan methods: it computes the callgraph reverse-postorder/indexing used for function ordering and implements the use_summary_p policy. Unlike analysis-plan.h, this is the executable policy logic rather than the class interface.
